english.title: Cause the carrying out of a prohibited procedure on a protected animal
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused a prohibited procedure, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROCEDURE..), to be carried out on a protected animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 5(1)(b) and 32(1) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause to be carried out on a protected animal a procedure prohibited by s 5 Animal Welfare Act 06

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 2 of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that a "Protected animal" is one of a kind which is commonly domesticated in the British Islands, is under the control of man whether on a permanent or temporary basis, or it is not living in a wild state.
(ii) See section 5 of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 for explanation and exceptions.
(iii) See section 33 for privation orders.
(iv) See section 34 for disqualification from owning keeping animals.
(v) See section 35 for power to seize animals in connection with disqualification.
(vi) See section 37 for destruction in the interests of the animal.
(vii) See section 40 for the forfeiture of equipment used.
(viii) The maximum penalty for this offence has increased from 29th June 2021; for offences before that date see H8883/AW06004.

other.timelimitforprosecutions: Complex see section 31 of the Act
other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Note
Section 32(4A) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that in relation to an offence committed before the commencement of paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 2 to the Sentencing Act 2020, the reference to 12 months is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Complex see legislation
